authored_with.method: Original periodic scalar fields and physically scaled gradients; no external image inputs

art_direction.use: Owner-approved visual reference. No source image pixels sampled.

pipeline.bake: Cycles CPU, two threads, one sample. Analytic fields to scene-linear EMIT or tangent NORMAL on UV0, then RGB8 PNG.
pipeline.encoding: UASTC quality 2, role-specific linear/sRGB transfer, Zstandard level 18, generated mip chain, glTF top-left origin.
pipeline.review: EEVEE, 12 temporal samples; neutral studio, orthographic coupon and two one-to-one 2 × 2 repeat views.
pipeline.determinism: Identical PNGs, KTX2s, map and manifest JSONs across fresh builds. Editable blend verified by reopening and comparing exported material bindings.
iterations: First bake identified chitin roughness below the art-bible minimum; adjusted the roughness field and rechecked all texels.

First studio sheet exposed large polished spots on gunmetal and excessive near-axis highlights. Reduced finish contrast, changed the chitin growth warp, and moved the softbox off axis for the final comparisons.

rights.source: Original project-authored procedural designs. No third-party texture content or paid generation.
